title_zh: 确认成人零基础也能参加芭蕾体验课

scenario.goal_zh: 确认零基础参加者可以独自参加并约好首次到场时间

context_zh: 任在社区舞蹈社团咨询成人初学者体验课，西莉娅是该班教师。
author: author-phase06-c

sentences.speaker: Visitor Ren
sentences.text: I always associate ballet with children who started very young. Is this class really for adult beginners?

sentences.speaker: Instructor Celia
sentences.text: Yes. No previous dance experience is needed; we start with the simplest movements.

sentences.speaker: Visitor Ren
sentences.text: Can I come on my own? None of my friends wants to try it.

sentences.speaker: Instructor Celia
sentences.text: Absolutely. You do not need a partner. The next taster session is Friday at six.

sentences.speaker: Visitor Ren
sentences.text: Then I would like to join that session. What should I bring?

sentences.speaker: Instructor Celia
sentences.text: Comfortable clothes and socks are enough for the first visit. Come to the main studio ten minutes early.

sentences.speaker: Visitor Ren
sentences.text: Great. I will be there at five fifty on Friday.

targets.sense_zh: 把某事物与另一事物联系起来
